reviewer_provenance.independence: Separate static audit of field schemas and call boundaries, without inspecting metric outcomes or desired scores.

scope.annotation_inspection: Only a few field-name examples were emitted from reviewed JSONL: source-role fields on lines 1-3 and one completion field example each on lines 76,81,91,96. No desired decisions, hard constraints, role/modality labels, completion values or metric results were emitted. Frozen packet schema and code definitions were inspected.

findings.observation: The scorer selects QueryIR requirements using r.field == oracle.field before comparing source_role/modality. Reviewed role annotations use native projection field names; the IR uses domain/family names.
findings.mechanism: For mismatched names, a correct source-owned IR requirement cannot enter match even when its span, role and modality are correct. The scorer then obtains empty actual_roles/actual_modalities and records comparisons as false. A role-correctness failure caused solely by this filter is not evidence of incorrect parser role assignment.
findings.interpretation: Any aggregate zero or other rate computed using these cross-namespace comparisons is contaminated and cannot be presented as a valid estimate of parser source-role/modality accuracy. Preserve the original reported value as a primary measurement artifact and identify the defect. This audit does not establish a corrected rate or imply every role annotation is correct.
boundaries: Fields that already have identical names, such as sort, language and availability, are not invalid merely because other names differ.
Span selection, enum agreement, multiple matching requirements, absent IR and oracle applicability can still cause genuine failures after a namespace mapping.

A role annotation field is a projection label here, not proof that an arbitrary native scalar itself is an IR requirement. Mapping must follow frozen definitions and must not choose a domain to maximize agreement.

findings.observation: Primary predictor forwards completion_input.field directly to issue_choice. Reviewed completion examples use rating_min, author_text, exclude_terms and subjects. issue_choice selects IR requirements by exact r.field == field, which instead expects rating, author, exclude and subject.
findings.mechanism: The mismatch makes the supplied field fail the native_adapter's unique source-owned operand selection. issue_choice raises ValueError before issue_completion, request construction, resolve_choice or recompile can test the proposed operand. The predictor catches this as a REJECTED completion_prediction.
findings.interpretation: This is a real failure of the captured predictor/adapter workflow as wired. It is not a valid zero estimate of the underlying source-owned completion semantics, nor evidence that the candidate successfully completed those cases. The semantic completion was not reached for the mismatched names.
boundaries: This static audit does not assert that correcting the namespace would make completion succeed: original IR presence, unique missing owner, placeholder selection, numeric validation, remaining requirements, preservation checks, capability checks and context binding still apply.
If the parser fails before completion or never represents a suitable missing IR owner, that remains a genuine separate failure.

Completion results already captured as rejections cannot be converted to success by a score-only namespace substitution. No successful completed plan is present merely because the adapter call was wrong.
Mock authorization and commit_performed=False cannot qualify live authorization, durable one-use choice consumption or Mongo CAS.

separate_diagnostic_assessment.primary_attempt_count: Remains 1; never overwrite, rename as successful, or replace the primary parser capture or its original score artifacts.
separate_diagnostic_assessment.source_role_diagnostic: A separate scorer may rescore already captured IR using a predeclared, frozen inverse mapping derived from FAMILIES, while preserving original oracles and outputting both original and mapped matches. No parser rerun is needed for that diagnostic. Report mappings, excluded/unmapped/ambiguous fields, denominators, residual failures and post-exposure status.
separate_diagnostic_assessment.completion_diagnostic: A separate input adapter may map native projection fields to IR domains before issuance. Testing resulting completions requires newly generated component outputs, not a reinterpretation of the already rejected captures. Such execution would be a separate now-exposed engineering diagnostic with a distinct script/output/freeze and explicit authorization; it must not recapture or replace the independent primary run. No such execution was performed in this audit.
mapping_rules: Derive mappings from the frozen FAMILIES relation, not from observed desired scores or case IDs.

Author_text -> author; title_text -> title; subjects/include_terms -> subject; exclude_subjects -> excluded_subject; exclude_terms -> exclude; formats/exclusive_formats -> format; excluded_formats -> excluded_format.

Rating bound projection names -> rating, and year bound projection names -> year, for domain matching only. The actual span, source operator and operand obligation must still identify the correct requirement; a field-name map cannot establish which of multiple numeric owners is completable.
Availability, physical_available_only, language and sort follow their frozen families. Identity names may pass through when independently defined as IR domains.

Do not guess a mapping for exact_text, semantic residue, structured preferences or unknown fields solely from similar spelling. Declare unsupported mappings N/A or require separately justified source-schema evidence.
Preserve blocking decisions, original annotations, scalar predicates, source spans, roles, modalities, ownership and trusted controls. A namespace bridge must not normalize semantic mismatches away.
separate_diagnostic_assessment.gate_reporting: Do not silently recompute the registered primary acceptance gate as if it had used the corrected adapter. Retain original outcomes and report the affected measurement/gate as defective or unqualified; report any mapped diagnostic outcome separately. This audit neither passes nor fails the candidate's substantive parser behavior.

evidence.supports: Direct cross-namespace equality filter precedes role/modality comparison.
Role/completion field annotations requested without an explicit IR-domain namespace bridge.
Actual IR-domain projection into native fields corroborates namespace distinction.
Native scalar fields listed by annotation schema.
Field-name-only examples: formats, author_text, title_text, rating_min and sort.
Direct field forwarding at line 97 and rejection capture before successful completion output.
Exact IR-domain field and unique mandatory missing-operand requirement for choice issuance.
Resolve binding, issue_completion dispatch and no implicit native-field conversion.
Completion domain ownership, marker and operand validation remain substantive requirements.
Completion field-name example author_text; additional examples exclude_terms at line 91 and subjects at line 96 are separately recorded above.
Primary role/completion metrics and gates are registered primary artifacts; rerun/recapture prohibited.
Full source recompilation, capabilities and untouched requirement preservation cannot be inferred from a field mapping.
Test-only adapter lacks durable lifecycle and production authorization IO.

limitations: No candidate or scorer execution, capture replay, role rescoring or completion retry occurred.
No corrected accuracy, denominator, count of impacted records, or substantive parser outcome is claimed.
A few annotation shapes establish the namespace contract mismatch; they do not establish uniformity or correctness of all annotations.

Main parser typed decisions and hard-field captures are a separate measurement path. This audit neither validates nor invalidates their independently assessed accuracy merely from the two adapter defects.
This review became possible after the primary population was exposed. Any corrected diagnostic is post-primary and cannot become a new independent primary evaluation.
conclusion: The role scorer and completion predictor use incompatible field namespaces at their component boundaries. Retain the primary artifacts unchanged and disclose the resulting measurement defects. A separately labeled now-exposed diagnostic with explicit frozen mappings is permissible; it cannot be called a fresh independent primary evaluation or erase the captured end-to-end workflow failures.
